Every existing Control Panel trigger is re-homed onto its screen, the Control Panel becomes the index (scenario jumps, clock and reset stay there), and the HL7/FHIR tooling gets interim Future-scope badges plus an S1 caveat.

phases.title: AA fee as its own monthly invoice
phases.goal: Step 1, re-greened on its own: stop netting the 5% AA fee from the ACCPAY, so the payable equals the receivable and a part payment releases exactly the amount received (US-10.2.1); reseed billing history, remove the Xero simulator's fee block and web Payments' fee columns, and re-baseline the S3 figures. Each fee invoice has its own number, billing case and simulated ACCREC against the anaesthetist's Xero contact; it is always a separate invoice paid into AA's own account, never netted against payables (Greg, 2026-10-02: trust law). The BCTI count runs through one pure, tested function (BCTIs for an anaesthetist in a month), the only place the count is made. Later phases that add invoices (22, 36, 38b, 39, 39b) feed it and must keep it the only count. Admin and web Accounts show the fee invoice paid or unpaid, and Xero pair records carry the invoice number and reference.
